{"change_type":"new_feature","detected_at":"2026-09-26","name":"`reflow2-mcp setup`: choose local or a remote server once; the key is checked against the server and kept in the OS keychain","rationale":"Anthony, 2026-09-26: "Go with the defaults, keychain first" — keychain as the key's home, a machine with no keychain told to keep the key in a named variable instead, and browser sign-in left for a later step (flo2's personal keys went live the same day, and Grok Build's own browser sign-in had just been seen failing against api.flo2.io, so a key is the path that works now).

WHY THE KEY IS CHECKED BEFORE IT IS SAVED: a key that is saved and wrong fails later, inside an agent session, where it reads as a reflow2 problem. Setup is the moment the person is paying attention, so a refusal or no answer saves nothing and says so there.

WHY THE KEY IS BOUND TO AN ORIGIN: `--remote` reads the stored key only for the same scheme, host and port it was set up for, so pointing a session at another server can never carry the key there.

WHY keyring's v1 MODE: it has no in-memory fallback. A store that silently "kept" the key only for the life of the process would make setup look done and fail at the next start.","rationale_basis":"contemporaneous","summary":"cap:one-setup-command-chooses-local-or-remote, partially satisfying req:one-setup-command-chooses-local-or-remote-once. New: client_setup.rs (settings file with the mode, the server's origin and where the key is; OsKeychain over keyring 4's v1 stores; check_server against `<origin>/mcp`; stored_credential for `--remote`), the `setup` subcommand in main.rs (show / local / remote <url> [--api-key-env VAR [--no-keychain] | --no-key] / forget; a hidden prompt or a pipe when no variable is named), and a typed ServerAnswered error in mcp_http.rs so setup can tell a refused key from a server with no account address. `--remote <url>` with no key flag now carries the key set up for that url's origin only. Two new dependencies: keyring 4 (default v1: Apple Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, zbus Secret Service) and rpassword 7. The step-1 remote-client tests now run with an empty settings folder, so a developer's own setup cannot leak into them."}
